question: Which of the following monetary instruments of RBI is qualitative in nature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moral Suasion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Moral suasion** is a** qualitative monetary instrument** used by the **RBI **to **persuade banks** to act in a certain way without actually mandating them to do so.
 
• It involves using **informal communication** and** persuasion techniques** to influence the** behavior of banks **and other financial institutions.
 
• This instrument is used to maintain** financial stability, regulate credit flow, and ensure compliance **with monetary policy objectives.
 
• **Cash reserve ratio, bank rate, and open market operations **are all quantitative monetary instruments that involve **controlling the supply of money** in the economy through** direct interventions** in the money market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cash reserve ratio** is the percentage of **deposits** that banks are required to keep with the **RBI **as a reserve.
 
• **Bank rate **is the** interest rate** at which the RBI lends to **commercial banks.**
 
• **Open market operations** involve **buying and selling government securities **to control the money supply.
 
• Hence, the** correct answer **is option 1 - Moral suasion.
